newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre to upgrade ProNet's network.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre to upgrade ProNet's network.

text.p: The Wireless Messaging Group of Glenayre Technologies said Tuesday that ProNet Inc a wireless service provider, has placed an order for paging infrastructure equipment to build out its recently acquired nationwide frequency throughout the southeastern United States. The upgrade and expansion is valued at approximately $3.5 million.

Under the agreement, Glenayre will provide ProNet with GL-T8500/T8600 transmitters, GL-C2000 controllers and GL-S2164 satellite receivers to expand the network's coverage. The equipment upgrades and additions include seven additional GL3000 Wireless Messaging Switches that will greatly increase the network's subscriber capacity and support of high speed paging protocols, including FLEX.
